priceYear.quote: Sample costs for labor, materials, equipment and custom services are based on current figures. (Current at the time of the study, so the study year 2011 is used.)

acresFarmed.quote: The hypothetical farm consists of 100 contiguous acres.

acresCrop.quote: Production costs are based on the 40 acres planted to a late harvested variety of cling peach.

laborMachineRate.quote: Labor rates of $17.29 per hour for machine operators and $10.97 for general labor includes payroll overhead of 33%.

laborNonMachineRate.quote: Labor rates of $17.29 per hour for machine operators and $10.97 for general labor includes payroll overhead of 33%.

laborOverheadPct.quote: Labor rates of $17.29 per hour for machine operators and $10.97 for general labor includes payroll overhead of 33%.

fuelPriceDiesel.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and gasoline are $2.60 (excludes excise tax) and $3.10 per gallon, respectively.

fuelPriceGas.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and gasoline are $2.60 (excludes excise tax) and $3.10 per gallon, respectively.

yieldStatement.quote: In this study, the average yield over the life of a mature orchard is 20 tons per acre.

priceStatement.quote: The contracted price for the 2010-2011 season was $287 per ton and is used to determine potential profits/losses.

capitalRecoveryFormula.quote: The formula for the calculation of the annual capital recovery costs is ((Purchase Price – Salvage Value) x Capital Recovery Factor) + (Salvage Value x Interest Rate).

salvageMethod.quote: Salvage value is an estimate of the remaining value of an investment at the end of its useful life.

machineLaborFactor.quote: Labor for operations involving machinery are 20% higher than the operation time given in Table 2 to account for the extra labor involved in equipment set up, moving, maintenance, work breaks, and field repair.
